      Your broker

      Not connected

      Pick your broker and follow the four steps. Your MT5 password stays inside MT5. Never type it here.

      How it connects

      1. Open an accountCreate an MT5 account (demo or real) with FBS, Exness or HFM.
      2. Install the bridge in MT5A small Expert Advisor file goes in MQL5/Experts. Only this part places orders.
      3. Allow web requestsIn MT5 open Tools, Options, Expert Advisors and allow WebRequest for the bot's address.
      4. Keep MT5 runningMT5 stays open on a Windows PC or VPS. This app is the dashboard and brain, MT5 is the hands.

      Where the analysis comes from

      • Indicators and trendEMA, RSI and ATR, from the trading_skills project.
      • Sizing and risk gatesFixed-fraction sizing, drawdown breaker and pre-trade checklist, from claude-trading-skills.
      • News filterForexFactory weekly calendar, free and keyless.
      • BacktestingMT5 Strategy Tester through the mt5-robot-tester pipeline on Windows.

      The analysis runs on this site. MT5 stays on your PC with the small bridge file, and the card at the top of this page shows what the bridge reports.

      Terms of use

      Last updated November 15, 2026

      These terms cover your use of spaceXBot, a tool that watches the market, applies your risk rules and sends trade requests to your own MT5 account. By creating an account or using the app you agree to them.

      Trading leveraged products such as forex and CFDs carries a high risk of loss. Only trade money you can afford to lose.

      What spaceXBot does

      spaceXBot gives market readings, runs strategies you switch on and enforces limits you set, such as the daily loss cap and news pauses. It does not hold your money. Orders are placed by the bridge in your own MT5 terminal, with your broker.

      Demo data

      While no broker is connected, every number in the app is sample data. Demo results say nothing about how a strategy will perform with real money.

      Not financial advice

      Nothing in spaceXBot is investment, tax or legal advice. Market readings and strategy outputs are information. You decide what to trade and how much to risk.

      Your account

      • Give accurate details and keep your login private.
      • Never share your broker password with anyone, including us.
      • You are responsible for activity under your account and for keeping MT5 running.

      Acceptable use

      Do not misuse the service, attempt to break it, resell it, or use it to break the law or your broker's rules.

      No guarantees

      The service is provided as is. Prices, connections and brokers can fail, and a bot can lose money. We do not promise profit, uptime or that every order will fill.

      Limit of liability

      To the extent the law allows, spaceXBot is not liable for trading losses or indirect damages that come from using the app.

      Changes and contact

      We may update these terms and will change the date above when we do. Questions: support@yourdomain.com.

      Privacy policy

      Last updated November 15, 2026

      This page explains what spaceXBot collects, why, and the choices you have.

      What we collect

      • Account details you enter, such as name, email and country.
      • Your bot settings, goals and onboarding answers.
      • Trade and activity history shown in the app.
      • Broker connection details you add, such as server name and account number. Never your broker password.
      • Basic device and usage data, if you allow analytics cookies.

      Why we use it

      To run the app, apply your risk rules, show your history, keep your account secure and improve the product. We do not sell your personal data.

      Where it is stored

      Settings and history are saved so the app can remember you between visits. Service providers that host or secure the app may process data for us under their own privacy terms.

      Your choices

      • Change or delete your details in Settings.
      • Ask us for a copy or deletion of your data at support@yourdomain.com.
      • Change cookie choices at any time from the footer.

      Security and age

      We use reasonable safeguards, but no system is perfectly secure. spaceXBot is for people 18 or older.

      Updates

      If this policy changes, the date above changes too.

      Cookie policy

      Last updated November 15, 2026

      Cookies and similar storage are small files or entries in your browser. spaceXBot uses them to keep you signed in, remember your theme and, only if you agree, to understand how the app is used.

      TypeWhat it doesCan you turn it off?
      EssentialKeeps you signed in and keeps the app working.No
      PreferencesRemembers theme, bot settings and onboarding progress.Yes
      AnalyticsShows us which screens are used so we can improve them.Yes

      Your choices

      Pick Accept all, Essential only or Choose on the cookie banner. You can reopen it from Cookie settings in the footer whenever you like. Your browser settings can also block or clear cookies, though parts of the app may stop working.
